verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.heading: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.body: Thanks for signing up. Confirm that this address is yours to activate your account. The link expires in 24 hours.

confirmEmailChange.heading: Confirm your new email
confirmEmailChange.body: You asked to use this address for your account. Confirm it to complete the change. The link expires in 1 hour. If it wasn't you, ignore this email.

emailChangeNotice.subject: Email change requested
emailChangeNotice.heading: Email change requested
emailChangeNotice.body: Someone asked to change the email of your account to {newEmail}. The change only takes effect once that address is confirmed. If it wasn't you, change your password now.

passwordChanged.subject: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.heading: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.body: The password of your account was just changed. If it wasn't you, contact an administrator.
